liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Iko Iko** (3 reviews, 1 other source): Iko Iko into Watchtower with Santana was sizzling; Iko into Watchtower with Carlos blew the roof off [1][16][22][24]
- **Box of Rain** (2 reviews): Box of Rain was a surprise opener; Box was a warm, mood-lifting if not explosive opener [16][19]
- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Jack Straw tried hard, but its energy was erratic; Jack Straw was energetic, though Jerry has played it better and longer elsewhere [19][22]
- **High Time** (1 review): High Time was sung with poignancy and sparse enough to savor the setting [19]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (1 review): In Watchtower, Carlos and Jerry traded increasingly fiery solos; After Jerry's last lead he nodded to Carlos to continue; Carlos bowed respectfully and waved him on instead [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-08-23.142332.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.oade.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 141 min [1]
- **gd87-08-23.sbd.gardner.4233.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 138 min; rated 4.11/5 by 19 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer prefers it to a soundboard because of the pleasant ambient sound [15]
- **gd1987-08-23.142157.UltraMatrix.sbd.bm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 142 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1987-08-23.fob.thompson.motb-0072.92277.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 131 min [13]. Said about its sound: Recording sounds very good despite the info file, though audience talking intrudes on the last two Garcia ballads [25]

## Around the show

- The fairgrounds called its summer concerts a series; the Dead closed it, after acts like Journey, the Doobies and Foreigner [14]
- An aerobatic air show flew from the airstrip right behind the venue [14]
- National press covered a woman who, three days later, emerged from the woods into a stranger's living room and slept on his couch [14]
- Santana sat in with the band at this show [17]
- Reviewer remembers a light show seen through the dust, feeling part of a rainbow of lights [21]
- Reviewer was among the backstage dishwashers working for Avery Ranch Catering over the years [21]
- Reviewer recalls an unusually large number of feds present [22]
- Reviewer attended both nights and recalls the air show and parachutists [23]
- Reviewer finds more energy than the previous night, 8/22, and says energy doesn't drop off as it did then [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-08-23.142332.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.oade.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Blake Jacobs; source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC3/MK41mics > Oade M118 > Oade modified Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM > Sek'd Prodif >… [1]
- **gd87-08-23.sbd.gardner.4233.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> MC> DAT> CDR> EAC> shn [2]
- **gd1987-08-23.142157.UltraMatrix.sbd.bm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Beta HiFi Master (Sony Betamax/TDK HS) [3]. Also: UltraMatrix soundboard-based file set, Miller, in 16 bit at 44.1 [3]
- **gd1987-08-23.fob.thompson.motb-0072.92277.flac16**: taped by Danny Thompson; transferred by Adam Egert and Derek McCabe; source: 2 x AKG C460 CK61uls > Uher CR240 > MAC (FOB) [13]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Calaveras County Fairgrounds - August 23, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/august-23-1987) [32]
